settings.question: What are Snacklaces?
settings.answer: Snacklaces are wearable pretzel necklaces that are super fun to wear and even better to eat! Each one is handmade with tasty ingredients and lots of love by 7-year-old snack boss, Shea. 🥨

settings.question: What flavors do you offer?
settings.answer: We offer four delicious flavors: Original Pretzel ($3), Chocolate Pretzel ($5), White Chocolate Pretzel ($5), and Gluten-Free Pretzel ($5)!

settings.question: Are Snacklaces safe for kids?
settings.answer:
Yes! Our Snacklaces are made with simple, snackable ingredients. However, because they contain small pieces, we recommend adult supervision for children under 3 years old. Safety first, snacks second! 💛

See our Ingredients & Allergens page for full details.

settings.question: What ingredients are in your Snacklaces?
settings.answer: We use quality pretzels, creamy coatings, and simple baking ingredients. See our What's Inside & Allergens page for complete ingredient lists.

settings.question: Do you offer gluten-free options?
settings.answer: Yes! Our Gluten-Free Pretzel Snacklace is made with certified gluten-free pretzels so everyone can snack along!

settings.question: How should I store my Snacklaces?
settings.answer: Store your Snacklaces in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. In warm weather, keep chocolate snacklaces cool so they don't melt!

settings.question: How long do Snacklaces stay fresh?
settings.answer: Snacklaces stay fresh, crunchy, and delicious for up to 3 weeks in their sealed packaging.

settings.question: Do you ship everywhere?
settings.answer: We currently ship anywhere in the United States! Orders typically process in 1-2 business days.

settings.question: Can I order Snacklaces for a party or event?
settings.answer: Absolutely! Check out our Party Packs (10, 20, or 50 count) or reach out via our Contact page for custom party orders!

settings.heading: SNACK QUESTIONS?
settings.subhead: We've got answers! If you don't see yours, just reach out — we love hearing from our Snack Squad! 💛
settings.contact_subhead: We're here to help and love hearing from you! ♡
